AxTableField.Name: Warehouse
AxTableField.HelpText: The warehouse selected on the device at its last sync.

AxTableField.Name: Scope
AxTableField.HelpText: Blank: the device holds every item. A warehouse: only that store's assortment.
AxTableField.Label: Assortment of warehouse

AxTableField.Name: LastFull
AxTableField.HelpText: Yes: the last successful sync downloaded every item again. No: only the changes.
AxTableField.Label: Full sync

AxTableField.Name: Items
AxTableField.HelpText: Items received in the last successful sync (a full sync: every item the device holds).
AxTableField.Label: Items

AxTableField.Name: SyncSeconds
AxTableField.HelpText: Time the device spent on the last successful sync.
AxTableField.Label: Sync seconds

AxTableField.Name: HealthStatus
AxTableField.HelpText: Worked out at each report and check-in, and every hour by the device health job.
AxTableField.Label: Health status

AxTableField.Name: LastSeenUtc
AxTableField.HelpText: The device's last item sync report or check-in. Not seen: nothing for 24 hours.
AxTableField.Label: Last seen

AxTableField.Name: QueuePending
AxTableField.HelpText: Postings on the device waiting to reach D365FO, at its last check-in.
AxTableField.Label: Postings waiting

AxTableField.Name: QueueFailed
AxTableField.HelpText: Postings D365FO refused that the device still shows in Activity, at its last check-in.
AxTableField.Label: Postings refused

AxTableField.Name: OldestQueuedUtc
AxTableField.HelpText: Since when the oldest waiting posting has waited. Postings stuck: more than 30 minutes.
AxTableField.Label: Oldest waiting since
